criteria.tolerance: Independent reconstruction of all 32 inventory rows, FCC geometry and descriptors; actual Slurm submission scripts bind the pre-result choice and input manifest to the runner attempt. Candidate timestamps alone do not establish chronology.

criteria.tolerance: Check all three strict A/B pairs, valid multi-allocation schedules up to the six-task study, positive finite actual resources matched to Slurm/native metadata, actual execution records and the Harbor attempt deadline. Permit equivalent scientifically valid settings.

verification_basis.rationale: 位点能差必须由真实周期引擎的完整原生输入和输出支撑。

criteria.tolerance: Check bound native execution, normal terminal state, energy and XML consistency, electronic convergence, finite extrapolated energy, top-band occupancy, fixed geometry and per-atom local moments; forces are diagnostic.

verification_basis.rationale: 结论仅由同条件位点A/B能差及其数值和磁性响应确定，必须将完整未决与证据缺失区分。

criteria.tolerance: Recompute the three deltas, numerical and signed alternate-start response and strict exploratory rule; accept complete UNDECIDED, require deterministic report to equal validated structured claims, and reject unsupported scope claims.
